My all time favorite movie is a little random flick called Box Elderwiki IMDB. I ended up watching it during the summer right before I went to college and my entire idea of what college was completely changed. I let my idea of the perfect college life with everything planned out years in advance drop, and I couldn't have been happier for it. Plus the idea presented in the end about the make-or-break moments in life being so small and insignificant that they are easily overlooked for the big signs that never come, really became a sort of idea to live by for me. The soundtrack was another amazing part that I'll never forget; I listened to Hockey Night more that year than I'm willing to admit.
